svg.title: A-04 Interior Cutaway — Second Floor
svg.text: External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. The second floor as a doll's house, its walls cut 1.20 m
above the floor and seen from the south-west, which is the
2. Not a render, and not redrawn. The walls come back from
the same probe that validates the plans, so this is A-102
in three dimensions and cannot be a different building.
3. A window leaves the wall under it standing to its sill; a
door leaves a gap to the floor. Both come from the opening
4. The stair is cut where the walls are cut, so the flight
stops at 1.20 m and the half landing above it, with the
flight off it, is dashed as an element above the cut
plane. Treads, rise and going are the ones fixtures.stair
draws in plan: 18 risers at 183 × 260 in two 0.90 m
5. Faces are painted back to front rather than depth-sorted,
so a detail may overlap where two surfaces nearly touch.
6. Rooms of 8 m² and over are named on the floor they stand
on. The ensuites, stores and WCs are not: at this scale
ten names a floor is a thicket, and A-102 schedules every
7. For looking at. Nothing is dimensioned here and nothing
EZBIT ABU RUKBAH, QUESNA, MENOUFIA, EGYPT
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
